title: TECC Specter Tank 2ml
description: The TECC Specter tank 2ml is designed to be used with the TECC Specter kit, but the 510-connector enables the tank to be used with any compatible vape mod. The tank uses a simple filling mechanism: just unscrew the top of the tank and fill with e-liquid – there’s no need to remove the whole tank from the mod. Adjustable Airflow lets you dial-in to your preferred draw intensity. The Specter tank uses TECC’s own GT coils for both sub-ohm and MTL vaping. The kit comes with two 1.2ohm GT coils which offer a super-satisfying mouth-to-lung style vape full of flavour. These coils are also push-to-fit making them easy to install with zero mess. The TECC Specter Vape Tank is especially suited for MTL vaping when paired with Classic/High PG , 50/50 and Nicotine Salts e-liquids.
